open_points.subject: TrialCase.expected_outputs completeness (M06, A04 rule 3)
open_points.text: "expected_outputs: StoredValues by output port ... absent when only the absence of failure is required" and "if the case states expected outputs, every output's digest equals the expected one"
open_points.question: When expected_outputs is present, must it name all output ports exactly, or may it name only a subset to assert partial expectations?
options: Require exact output-port set when expected_outputs is present
Allow subset expectations and compare only listed ports
open_points.default_guess: Require the exact output-port set whenever expected_outputs is present.

open_points.subject: File media-type equality in proof (A05 phase 3)
open_points.question: Is media-type equality byte-for-byte string equality, or MIME-normalized equality (case-insensitive type/subtype, parameter handling rules)?
options: Type/subtype case-insensitive equality, with explicit parameter normalization rules

open_points.subject: Size-bound semantics for `many` value ports (A12 rule 1, A04 rule 1)
open_points.text: "for a `many` port, is a JSON array whose every element fits it — and is within `stored_value_bytes_max`" and "every value is within `stored_value_bytes_max`"
open_points.question: For a `many` value, is the size limit applied to the whole array encoding, to each element, or both?
options: Both whole array and each element
open_points.default_guess: Apply the limit to the whole encoded array value only.

open_points.subject: Approval preview for `many` file inputs (A10 rule 2)
open_points.text: "for each file input, its digest, size and media type"
open_points.question: For a `many` file input, what exact preview structure/order is shown and therefore approved (single aggregate item vs per-element list in order)?
options: Show one entry per file element in list order
Show one aggregated summary per port
open_points.default_guess: Show one entry per file element in list order.
